claim: You can manage Aurora automated (continuous) backups in AWS Backup and restore to specified times from them; the document history lists this on September 7, 2023.
question: What did the September 2023 change let you do with Aurora continuous backups and AWS Backup?

values.display: restore to specified times from them
values.spoken: restore to specified times from them

qualifiers.scope: Aurora automated (continuous) backups managed in AWS Backup

note: d27-073. Chapter 24 owns AWS Backup. The Aurora PITR page confirms: if the cluster has an AWS Backup plan, that plan is used for point-in-time recovery.
